verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no automations feature (scheduled or triggered workflows) in Lovable, and nothing about versioning, reviewing, or rolling back such automations. The available evidence covers versioning and review of project code instead: Git sync, pull-request review, Build-mode file diffs, and edit history. That is an adjacent capability, and no rollback is evidenced even for code. A builder of this kind could plausibly ship automations, so the axis applies and the verdict is "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
